name: 静音速干恒温柔发电吹风款

styleLock.backgroundSystem: blush pink #F3D9D4 seamless backdrops and rounded cards alternating with deep cocoa #4A2621 feature panels
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm soft studio key from the front-left, gentle diagonal window-shadow accents on backdrops, soft grounded contact shadows
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper backdrop and flat matte card surfaces, no reflective tabletop
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal #2B2624 or white #FFFFFF, all copy wrapped in 「」, no mixed fonts
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons in the coral accent, consistent rounded rectangular info cards
styleLock.presentationRules: stable three-quarter hero angle and consistent product scale across the set, product centered or anchored to one column
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium warm hair-care appliance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of blush pink #F3D9D4, deep cocoa brown #4A2621, charcoal text #2B2624 and one coral accent #BE6A5F; warm soft studio lighting with a gentle key from the front-left and soft diagonal window-shadow accents, soft grounded contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal or white; consistent rounded rectangular info cards and thin-line icons in the coral accent; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable three-quarter hero product angle and consistent scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
